title: KChime Analytics Event Catalog
description: Canonical event schema. All values are enums or primitives — no freeform user text.

privacy.pii_policy: No message content, contact names, emails, phone numbers, or location data are ever included in any event property.
privacy.identity: Devices are identified by a one-way SHA-256 hash of an anonymous UUID stored in App Group UserDefaults. No Apple User ID is forwarded.
privacy.char_count_policy: Character counts are bucketed (xs/s/m/l/xl) before transmission. Exact counts are never sent.

device_id_hash.description: SHA-256(anonymousDeviceID).slice(0,16) — consistent for cohort analysis, not reversible to a real ID.

ts.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the event.

is_first_launch.description: True on the very first launch after install.

onboarding_completed.description: User finished the full onboarding flow.

onboarding_abandoned.description: User left the onboarding flow without completing it.

generation_requested.description: User tapped Generate in the keyboard or share extension. Fired before the API call.

relationship_used.description: Whether a relationship profile was selected.

generation_completed.description: AI generation response received (success or failure).

char_count_bucket.description: Bucket for the incoming message length.

suggestion_inserted.description: User tapped a suggestion to insert it into the text field.

char_count_bucket.description: Bucket for the inserted suggestion length.

tone_chip_tapped.description: User tapped a tone modifier chip (Shorter, More formal, More friendly, Rewrite).

rewrite_chip_blocked.description: Free user tapped the Pro-only Rewrite chip and was shown an upgrade prompt.

product_id.description: App Store product identifier, e.g. com.kchime.app.pro.monthly

subscription_restored.description: User successfully restored a previous purchase.

subscription_cancelled.description: Entitlement revoked client-side (detected via RevenueCat delegate).

promise_detected.description: PromiseDetector found a commitment phrase in an inserted suggestion.

promise_confirmed.description: User tapped 'Set' to schedule a reminder from the promise banner.

promise_dismissed.description: User dismissed the promise banner without setting a reminder.
